ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud, including the Feeding Our Future and autism fraud investigations, and explore potential patterns of abuse within the system
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in the US?
How do perpetrators carry out these schemes?
What can be done to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a widespread problem and spark meaningful change. By following the money and investigating the extent of Medicaid fraud, we can shed light on a critical issue and hold those responsible accountable.
